answer_text: Cato Sockets do not support jumbo frames on Socket LAN ports. When a LAN-port packet larger than 1500 bytes arrives, the Socket will either fragment it to comply with 1500 bytes (if the DF bit is not set) or drop it and send back an ICMP Fragmentation Needed message (if the DF bit is set). For a 9000-byte frame, behavior depends on the DF bit: if DF is not set, the frame is accepted and fragmented; if DF is set, the frame is dropped and an ICMP Fragmentation Needed is generated.
